posts.text: my aries mars walked into the buffalo bayou cistern, saw 221 concrete columns and immediately yelled my own name. the echo held it for seventeen full seconds. finally, a room in houston that agrees with me at my volume
posts.caption: The cistern repeats you. Aries calls that support.

posts.text: my aries sun sat down for dim sum at ocean palace in the hong kong city mall and ordered for the whole table before the menus landed. nobody asked me to lead. i simply sensed a power vacuum and steamed buns
posts.caption: First to order, last to apologize.

posts.text: every winter discovery green turns kinder lake into an ice rink, and every winter my aries rising laces up like it's the olympic final. i have never once skated on purpose. i would still like you to watch me fall at full speed
posts.caption: Fire sign, frozen lake, zero hesitation.

posts.text: my aries moon watches coogs basketball at fertitta center like the phi slama jama days never ended. i did not play in the eighties. i am a grown adult in the upper rows, dunking emotionally on every single free throw
posts.caption: Cardinal fire, Big 12 volume.

posts.text: a taurus first date at truth bbq in the heights goes brisket, ribs, then one slice of the sky-high layer cake. you may look at the cake. you may not have the cake. this is not a red flag. this is venus guarding her assets
posts.caption: Ruled by Venus. Protected by frosting.

posts.text: my taurus moon found out lucille's in the museum district still bakes chili biscuits from the owner's great-grandmother's recipe, the same ones once served on american airlines. i don't need the flight. i need the basket and a booth until close
posts.caption: Comfort, first class, no boarding pass.

posts.text: my taurus sun stands in line at killen's in pearland with the calm of a monk. the building used to be a school cafeteria, and i have never been this happy to be back in a lunch line. the brisket earned every minute
posts.caption: Fixed earth, prime brisket, no cutting.

posts.text: pinkerton's barbecue asks if you want your pork ribs glazed or dry rub, and my taurus rising hears a hostage negotiation. i will be taking both, a pound of brisket and a quiet minute alone with my feelings
posts.caption: Venus does not do either-or.

posts.text: love bugs show up in houston every may and september and fly around permanently attached to their partner. my gemini sun finally understands them. two of us, one body, zero sense of direction, and everyone on the highway is annoyed
posts.caption: Twin energy, splattered on your windshield.

posts.text: the sugar land skeeters became the space cowboys, same ballpark, brand new everything. my gemini mercury respects a full rebrand. i do that to my whole personality every eighteen months and nobody has ever sent out a press release
posts.caption: New name, new colors, same Gemini.

posts.text: my gemini rising relates to the beer can house. a retired railroad man started flattening cans in 1968 and kept going for eighteen years because one idea turned into forty. that is every group chat i have ever started
posts.caption: One idea, eighteen years, thousands of cans.

posts.text: a gemini belongs in rice's marching owl band. a halftime show that is secretly a comedy sketch, props everywhere, gently roasting the other team, then calling it a serious musical performance? that is just how my gemini moon talks at brunch
posts.caption: Mutable air with a brass section.

posts.text: my cancer moon fully understands why beyoncé named her company parkwood after the third ward street she grew up on. you can sell out every stadium on earth and still want your childhood address written on the paperwork
posts.caption: Home is the headline for a water sign.

posts.text: a cancer will drive past five closer chicken spots to get to frenchy's on scott street, because it has been in the third ward since 1969 and it tastes like every family function where an auntie told me to fix a plate
posts.caption: Nostalgia, Creole-fried.

posts.text: admission to the menil is always free, which means my cancer sun can visit the same painting every sunday like an old friend. we don't talk. we just sit together. it never asks what i'm doing with my life
posts.caption: Free admission. Unlimited feelings.

posts.text: sharpstown opened in 1961 as houston's first enclosed, air-conditioned mall, and my cancer rising refuses to call it anything else. it has a new name now. i respect that. i'm just loyal to the first place that ever kept us cool
posts.caption: Some loyalties are climate controlled.

posts.text: megan thee stallion finished her health administration degree at texas southern in 2021 while being one of the most famous people alive. my leo sun took that personally. real hottie behavior is a stadium tour and a diploma. go finish the class
posts.caption: The bar is set. The bar has a degree.

posts.text: my leo rising does not want a quiet proposal. i want texas southern's ocean of soul marching up the block, high knees, full drumline, motion of the ocean dancing behind me. a ring in a cake is for other signs
posts.caption: Sun-ruled and requesting a drumline.

posts.text: a leo on the skylawn at post houston is not there for the five acres of rooftop park. a leo is there because golden hour hits downtown and the skyline is finally a backdrop worthy of me
posts.caption: Rooftop lighting, main character angle.

posts.text: my leo moon still brings up the 2022 astros at parties. not the box score. how i personally felt, in my living room, in a jersey, screaming at the television like it could hear me. it absolutely could
posts.caption: World Series champions, as narrated by a Leo.

posts.text: houston voters rejected zoning in 1948, 1962 and 1993, and my virgo sun respects democracy. i still flinch when a mansion, a taqueria and a tire shop share one block. it's not wrong. it's just not alphabetized
posts.caption: No zoning, many label makers.

posts.text: every march the oak pollen turns my car yellow and my virgo rising takes it personally. i wash it tuesday. by wednesday it looks like a lemon bar. the city once counted over ten thousand grains per cubic meter. i felt every one
posts.caption: Clean car, pending further notice.

posts.text: harris county has about fifty-six species of mosquito, and my virgo moon has tried to identify every single one that bit me on the patio. i have a spreadsheet. i have a ranking. i have not sat outside since june
posts.caption: Know your enemy, by species.

posts.text: a virgo on a date at rice will casually mention that campus has over four thousand trees, then ask which live oak you'd like to sit under, then explain why your pick is acceptable but not optimal for shade
posts.caption: Romance, peer reviewed.

posts.text: my libra venus goes to the bayou city art festival in memorial park for one small print. four hours later i have complimented every artist, bought nothing and promised forty booths i'll be back. i meant it every single time
posts.caption: Venus loves every booth equally.

posts.text: my libra sun cannot pick one houston college team. coogs at fertitta, owls at rice, tigers at texas southern. i own all three hoodies and rotate them weekly so nobody feels left out, including me
posts.caption: Neutral ground, three hoodies deep.

posts.text: my libra moon went to hillcroft for one sari for a wedding. the mahatma gandhi district has more than a dozen sari shops. i visited every one, loved every one, and left with three, purely for balance
posts.caption: Indecision, beautifully embroidered.

posts.text: rice village has over three hundred shops packed into a few walkable blocks, and my libra rising treated it like a jury duty. every store got a fair hearing. every outfit got a second opinion from a stranger. the verdict is pending
posts.caption: The scales are still deliberating.

posts.text: my scorpio mars knows the downtown tunnels the way other people know their ex's schedule. six miles, twenty feet underground, ninety-five blocks, and i can cross all of downtown without seeing the sun once. no, i will not draw you a map
posts.caption: Pluto prefers the underground route.

posts.text: a palmetto bug flew across the kitchen and my scorpio sun did not scream. i made eye contact, held the stare and let it understand that one of us is leaving this room tonight. respectfully, it will not be me
posts.caption: Fixed water versus a flying roach.

posts.text: my scorpio moon is fascinated by the old imperial sugar char house in sugar land. it's named for the bone char that turned dark syrup clear. something that pulls the darkness out of things? i'd like to be studied there
posts.caption: Pluto respects a good filtration process.

posts.text: nobody handed my scorpio rising a flyer for the night market behind the hong kong city mall. i noticed the lot getting busy after dark, followed the smell and quietly found my new favorite stall. i will be telling no one which one
posts.caption: Secrets, served after sunset.

posts.text: my sagittarius sun rode the free trolley around the woodlands waterway and announced i was 'exploring the region.' it is a 4.1 mile loop. i rode it three times. i have traveled further than most people this week
posts.caption: Jupiter counts every lap as a journey.

posts.text: a sagittarius will say 'let's just grab one boba in asiatown' and four hours later we're in a different plaza, a karaoke room and a conversation about moving abroad. the boba was real. the itinerary never was
posts.caption: One drink, three plazas, a whole new life plan.

posts.text: my sagittarius rising suggests 'let's drive westheimer until something looks good' like it's a quick idea. westheimer is about nineteen miles long. we passed every cuisine on earth twice and ended up eating in the car at a light
posts.caption: Jupiter treats one street as a road trip.

posts.text: my sagittarius sun shows up to a texans tailgate at nrg with no chair, no cooler and no plan, then leaves having been fed by six different families and invited to somebody's cousin's wedding in june
posts.caption: Jupiter provides, mostly in brisket.

posts.text: my capricorn sun respects bun b. a port arthur legend turns a pop-up into trill burgers in montrose, then keeps opening locations around houston. that is not a side hustle. that is a five-year plan with pickles
posts.caption: Trill, and also on schedule.

posts.text: when ercot sends out a conservation appeal my capricorn moon sets the thermostat to exactly 78, unplugs the garage fridge and texts the neighbors. i'm not scared. somebody on this block has to be the adult on the grid
posts.caption: Saturn rules structure, including the thermostat.

posts.text: the deluxe theater on lyons avenue in the fifth ward opened in 1941, waited decades, got restored and raised the curtain again. my capricorn rising calls that a career arc. good bones, long patience, and the lights still come on
posts.caption: Built to last, then built again.

posts.text: molina's has served tex-mex since 1941 and is still run by the founders' grandsons. my capricorn saturn reads that and sees a legacy plan. three generations, one queso recipe and a dip named after a waiter who had a good idea
posts.caption: Family business, Saturn approved.

posts.text: an aquarius at smither park sees a long mosaic wall made from broken plates, bottle caps and found objects by over three hundred artists and thinks, finally, a community that understands how i decorate my apartment
posts.caption: Found objects, chosen family.

posts.text: my aquarius moon spent a whole afternoon at the menil drawing institute looking at sketches, studies and things artists never fully finished, and felt seen. i also have forty half-finished ideas. i believe they belong in a museum too
posts.caption: Uranus collects works in progress.

posts.text: my aquarius rising secretly loves that houston never adopted zoning. a dentist, a church, a dance studio and a townhouse on one block? that is not chaos. that is a city where everybody did the group project their own way
posts.caption: Fixed air, flexible land use.

posts.text: my aquarius sun goes to houston dash games at shell energy stadium because women's soccer deserves a loud, full house, and i deserve a crowd that chants with the exact intensity i bring to a group chat about social issues
posts.caption: Ahead of the curve and in the supporters section.

posts.text: my pisces moon stood in the buffalo bayou cistern, watched 221 columns reflect into the still water and heard one whisper hang in the air for seventeen seconds. i did not take a photo. i quietly forgave three people
posts.caption: Neptune found its underground chapel.

posts.text: my pisces sun went up to the post houston rooftop, skipped the bar and drifted straight to the one-acre farm to talk to the tomatoes. i came for a date. i'm leaving emotionally attached to a row of basil that faces the skyline
posts.caption: Neptune grows things on rooftops.

posts.text: my pisces venus went to the bayou city art festival and fell in love three times: with a watercolor of the bayou, with the woman who painted it and with a stranger's dog who stood next to me the whole time
posts.caption: Mutable water, unlimited crushes.

posts.text: at the deluxe theater in the fifth ward the lights went down, a local choir started singing and my pisces rising cried before the first verse ended. i don't know any of them. i'd still help every one of them move
posts.caption: Boundaries dissolve at curtain call.
